choice.basis: The dashboard's color legend (r1.O1) is a vertical scale with “High”/100 at the light-yellow top and “Low”/0 at the dark-red bottom. The labeled state fills are: NH very pale yellow (r1.O2), DE orange (r1.O3), and FL dark burgundy (r1.O4). On this monotonic legend, the lighter fill corresponds to the higher plotted value, so NH > DE > FL. The task explicitly instructs using this state dashboard as the evidence source for the routing decision (r2.B), so the highest-plotted state among the options is the one to route.
choice.option_label: Open New Hampshire (NH) statistics view for priority follow-up
